name: sympathetic magic

attributes.attribute: the belief that like attracts like
an object that could draw the attention of a mermaid
used a comb and liked to drown sailors

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sympathetic magic is a cosmological concept found in many cultures. The core idea is that like attracts like. An object shaped one way affects another object shaped the same way. A girl who combed her hair at home in the evening could draw the attention of a dangerous mermaid. The mermaid also used a comb at that hour and liked to drown sailors. A second form of the magic held that parts stay tied to the whole. Hair and nails cut from a person kept a quiet power over that person. An enemy could use the clipped hair or the parings against its owner. The practice reaches into the idea of the external soul, where a person's life is kept apart from the body.
